title: Julia Tuttle Causeway Shoreline Cleanup
description: King tides have left a wave of trash along the shoreline. Join us to help protect our bay. RSVP required at cleanmiamibeach.org. Wear closed-toe shoes and bring a reusable water bottle. Volunteers under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Community service hours are available. Check RSVP information for the precise meeting point.
flyerAlt: Post king tide cleanup flyer: December 19, Julia Tuttle Causeway westbound, 8–10 AM. RSVP at cleanmiamibeach.org. Closed-toe shoes required; bring a reusable water bottle. Ages under 16 must attend with a guardian. Community service hours provided.
